name: rig-example
description: Any rig example of rig/examples/suite.tsv (env RIG_EXAMPLE), unchanged, every node on this role's jar; pass = the example's PASS marker and rig exit 0 (rig/run-suite.sh's PASS), timed_out = the suite timeout was hit (pass false), rig_exit = rig.sh's status; RIG_EXAMPLE_ENV ('KEY:VALUE ...') overrides keys of the example's suite.tsv env. Both roles all(pass): a no-regression reading. Which examples run: rig-example.check.sh --list
